The corrected Description names the golf course and Mount Timpanogos views, so the 'golf grounds' cue gives Outdoors, which matches Sleepy Ridge Golf Course. If the team thinks a clubhouse venue shouldn't be Outdoors, the rule should require the event itself to be held outside, not just views.
